summary: The one-line fix adds an extra `self.default is UNSET` condition, so options with both flag_value and a default still require a value, contradicting the PR's own tests.

findings.explanation: `flag_value is not UNSET and self.default is UNSET` leaves `_flag_needs_value` False when a default is set. The new tests (`default="Default"`, `flag_value="FlagValue"`, args `--theflag`) expect `FlagValue`, but the option will demand a value and fail. The code comment also says either flag_value or default is sufficient.
